material_delta: Fresh repository liveness continues through metrics commit b86a776feacbebc1e7884fbc9e87f3e250ecb70c at 2026-08-26T16:46:06Z, so the legacy publication/control-plane path remains live after owner HARD_OFF. This does not prove provider calls or identify the executing host.

The previous v1 restart-attribution probe classified container/tmux/screen/nohup ancestry at MEDIUM confidence but only failed the process on UNKNOWN. That was insufficient for a safe P0 kill decision because execution authority requires unambiguous ownership, not a plausible mechanism class.

New tools/free_swarm_restart_authority_attribution_v2.py keeps the probe read-only and makes MEDIUM-confidence mechanisms explicitly non-actionable. SYSTEMD becomes actionable only when exactly one unit is bound by systemctl show/cat to a legacy entrypoint. CRON becomes actionable only with one exact matching scheduler source/entry.

New mutation/unit tests cover UNKNOWN, medium-confidence container attribution, bound/unbound systemd, exact cron and missing Clay process binding. Source/test files exist; repository-bound runtime execution remains pending.

Trigger-2 real-tokenizer work independently found that digit atoms split under leading-space rendering on the pinned checkpoint tokenizer. This keeps tokenizer/render ABI P1 open and does not change GO P0 runtime-quiescence priority.
